family.description: A small family of bacterial proteins, found in several Bacteroides species. Structure determination (NMR and Xray) shows an immunoglobulin beta-barrel fold. Multiple homologues have been found in human gut metagenomics data sets. Structural experimentation shows it to share features with two well-established protein architectures in the SCOP database, ie, C2 (calcium/lipid-binding domain) of [pfam:PF00168] and PLAT/LH2 (lipase/lipooxigenase domain) of [pfam:PF01477]. The C2 and PLAT/LH2 domains bind Ca2+ in their functions of targeting proteins to cell-membranes; this domain is also shown to bind Ca2+ as well as to be a novel fold [[cite:PUB00075637]].
family.name: PLAT/LH2 and C2-like Ca2+-binding lipoprotein
